# @vllnt/convex-comments

> Threaded comments / annotations on any resource — post, reply, edit, resolve, and soft-delete as a Convex component

`@vllnt/convex-comments` is a publishable Convex component. It targets `convex@^1.41.0`.
It stores one sandboxed table - `comments` (attached to a host-opaque `resourceRef`, authored by an opaque `authorRef`, optionally threaded under a `parentId`, holding a `status` of `open`/`resolved`/`deleted`, an opaque host `body`, an optional `editedAt`, and `createdAt`/`updatedAt` server timestamps). A host mutation calls `post(resourceRef, authorRef, body, parentId?)` to attach a comment and gets its id back; the original author calls `edit`, `remove` (soft-delete), or `resolve` (a non-author caller is rejected with `NOT_AUTHOR`); clients page a resource's thread with `list(resourceRef, paginationOpts, { parentId?, includeDeleted? })` or tally it with `count(resourceRef)` (reactively in Convex). A reply must link a parent on the same, non-deleted resource. Soft-delete keeps the row (preserving replies) but clears the body; a bounded, self-rescheduling `prune` (and a built-in daily cron) sweeps deleted comments past a retention window. Time is read from the server clock inside every handler - no caller-supplied clock. The host owns the resource, the author identity, auth, and the `body` type (the client is generic over it, with an optional `bodyValidator` parser narrowing the opaque stored body at the boundary - never a `v.any()` dump); the component owns only the comment tree. Mount-safe: it runs correctly under multiple named `app.use` mounts.
